overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by mid-range fuel dryness (ERC 54%, BI 50%) even as cooler, calmer weather moves in.**

- Danger trends downward through the week, dropping to Low by Saturday, Nov. 1, as ERC falls toward 40% and temperatures cool into the 30s-40s.
- Winds stay light (5-9 mph) through Saturday, then pick up to around 18-20 mph early next week as a moisture system arrives.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are met today, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect; NWS shows no active alerts for the area.
- BLM's Uncompahgre Field Office lifted Stage 1 fire restrictions on September 18, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect. Ouray County also rescinded all fire restrictions for unincorporated areas effective September 18.
- No new or uncontained wildfires are reported in or near this area's counties in the latest national situation report; expect light rain (up to 0.22") Saturday into Sunday to further ease conditions.
